Activity is counted in the week it happened, to 4 Oct. Each indicator point is the figure as of a saved report; a gap is a report with too few communities to score, not a zero. Dashed line = target. Targets are the PDD's own (§8.1 P1 ≥ 80%, P3 ≥ 75%). Spark's participation indicators and the review flags carry no target in the PDD, so they are shown without one. Synthetic data: the five partners are invented examples, each marked (example) — the pilot design names one implementing organisation.
